title: Sequence Intelligence
reward: Learn that order can carry more meaning than count.
knowledge: Model path and status transitions, not isolated requests only.
Navigation, retries, crawlers and recon can share endpoints but differ in order and cadence.
Repeated failure followed by success is different from uniform probing.
Sequence similarity across sources is supporting evidence, not identity proof.
Missing steps reduce confidence; do not invent transitions.
challenge: Compare benign navigation and recon sequences.
Explain an incomplete sequence with explicit uncertainty.
next_requires: Use ordered evidence without narrative invention.
